moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Matchweek 8 of the Premier League is underway with a Friday night draw and a packed schedule for Saturday and Sunday, featuring major clashes like Chelsea vs Tottenham.

angles.name: Weekend Preview
angles.copy: Premier League Matchweek 8 is here! Ipswich and Forest kicked things off last night with a 1-1 draw. Who are you backing in today's big games like Aston Villa vs Man City and Chelsea vs Spurs?

angles.name: Sunday Showdowns
angles.copy: Ready for Super Sunday? Liverpool take on high-flying Brighton, plus Man Utd face Bournemouth and Crystal Palace host Newcastle. What are your predictions for today's Premier League action?

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Cardiff-born singer Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' has hit number one on the Official UK Singles Chart, making him the first Welsh artist in 15 years and first solo male Welsh artist in 41 years to achieve this.

angles.name: Welsh Pride
angles.copy: Massive congrats to Cardiff's own Jamie Miller! His track 'Babydoll' is officially the UK Number 1. First Welsh artist to do it in 15 years! Huge moment for Welsh music.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: The Official UK Singles Chart has a new leader: Jamie Miller with 'Babydoll'! A viral sensation turned chart-topper. What a week for the Welsh singer!

moments.title: Melanie C Joins Strictly for Special Performance
moments.blurb: Melanie C will perform her hit 'Sweat' with the professional dancers on Sunday's Strictly Come Dancing results show, following the main competition on Saturday night.

angles.name: Spice Up Your Sunday
angles.copy: Get ready for some serious spice! Melanie C is joining the Strictly pros for a special performance of 'Sweat' on Sunday's results show. Who's tuning in?

angles.name: Strictly Saturday
angles.copy: Strictly Come Dancing is back tonight at 6:30pm on BBC One! Expect dazzling routines and high drama as the couples compete. Who are you rooting for this week?

moments.title: Halloween is One Week Away
moments.blurb: Halloween is celebrated next Saturday, October 31st, across the UK with various events, decorations, and trick-or-treating.

angles.name: Spooky Prep
angles.copy: Just one week until Halloween! Are your pumpkins carved, costumes ready, and spooky snacks planned? What's your favourite way to celebrate?

angles.name: Local Scares
angles.copy: Halloween is just around the corner! From trick-or-treating to local spooky events, how are you getting into the spirit this year?

moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaching
moments.blurb: Guy Fawkes Night, also known as Bonfire Night, is on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays and bonfires planned for the surrounding weekend.

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Bonfire Night is just under two weeks away on November 5th! Many communities will have firework displays over the weekend. Where are you planning to see some rockets?

angles.name: Fireworks Fun
angles.copy: Get ready for the crackle and pop! Bonfire Night is coming soon. Will you be heading to an organised display or enjoying a sparkler in the garden?

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity Returns in November
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here! is rumoured to begin on ITV on Monday, November 16th, with Ant & Dec returning to host.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown to the jungle is on! I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here! is expected to return mid-November. Who are you hoping to see in the lineup this year?

angles.name: Rumour Mill
angles.copy: Wayne Rooney, Jeremy Clarkson, Jesy Nelson... the I'm A Celeb rumour mill is in full swing! Who's your dream campmate for the new series, starting next month?

moments.title: RAYE Plays Royal Albert Hall
moments.blurb: UK star RAYE performs a special orchestral show at London's Royal Albert Hall tonight as part of 'This Symphony May Contain Hope'.

angles.name: Tonight's Show
angles.copy: Tonight in London: RAYE takes the stage at the iconic Royal Albert Hall for a unique orchestral performance. Who's lucky enough to be there?

angles.name: Live Music London
angles.copy: Huge night for RAYE fans! A special orchestral show at the Royal Albert Hall. What an incredible venue for such a talented artist.

moments.title: Duran Duran at The O2
moments.blurb: New Wave legends Duran Duran are set to play London's O2 Arena next Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: 80s Icons Live
angles.copy: Still got that Wild Boys energy! Duran Duran hit The O2 next Saturday, October 31st. Who's heading to see the New Wave legends?

angles.name: Halloween Gig
angles.copy: Spending Halloween with Duran Duran? The iconic band plays The O2 next Saturday. Get ready for some classic synth-pop bangers!

moments.title: Happy 67th to 'Weird Al' Yankovic

angles.name: Polka Power
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the legendary 'Weird Al' Yankovic! From 'Eat It' to 'White & Nerdy', what's your favourite parody track from the master of musical comedy?

angles.name: Comedy King
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th to the one and only 'Weird Al' Yankovic! Still making us laugh after all these years. What's his funniest music video?

angles.name: Smooth Grooves
angles.copy: Happy 41st birthday to R&B sensation Miguel! His soulful voice and unique style have given us so many memorable songs.

angles.name: Bass Hero
